strategy.earlyGame: By keeping your fighting spirit high, you can reduce the damage you take, so use attacks on minions to maintain your fighting spirit while laning. Approach the enemy with skill 1's charge and knockup, and aim for advantageous trades with skill 2's shield and damage. If there is an enemy within range while skill 2 is charging, skill 1's CD will be reset, allowing continuous charging and obstruction.
strategy.midGame: Utilizing Fighting Spirit's damage reduction and skill 2's shield, he actively jumps into enemy lines in small battles. Skill 3's continuous jump attack slows and knocks up enemies, so hit them on a group and create a starting point for your allies' attacks. When not in battle, your fighting spirit is converted into HP recovery, so take advantage of your high fighting ability, which allows you to easily stay in the lane even after battle.
strategy.lateGame: With up to 20% damage reduction and a thick shield, it is a very hard tank that is useful on the front lines. Combining skill 3's wide range CC and skill 1's rush, he penetrates deep into the enemy's territory and continues to thwart the enemy's main force. Since you will be in a super armor state while the skill is activated, you can ignore the enemy's CC and reliably break the formation.
strategy.teamfight: With skill 3, he jumps into the center of the enemy's formation, spreading damage, slowness, and knockup over a wide area. You can use skill 1 even during skill 3 or skill 2, so move to block the enemy's escape route and stack CC. Use your super armor while the skill is active to absorb the enemy's blocking skills and create an environment where your allies can attack safely.
strategy.commonMistakes: If you start a battle without having enough fighting spirit, there is a risk that you will not be able to receive damage reduction effects and be defeated sooner than expected. Also, skill 1 will not be reset if there are no enemies around when skill 2 is activated, so be careful of combo mistakes that will prevent you from running away after charging. You should also avoid relying too much on super armor and leaving yourself isolated on enemy lines.

synergy.reason: This is because Renki can stably inflict high firepower area damage while launching multiple enemies.
This is because marksmen can safely move around and create an opening for attacks from powerful initiations in group battles.

counters.reason: While being able to avoid attacks with its high mobility, it is also able to slowly chip away at the fixed damage that is effective against tanks.
Because it has long-distance poke and percentage damage, and Renki's durability and passive are easily ignored.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Warrior's Soul
passive.description: Becomes super armored while skill is active. Fighting spirit continues to increase while in combat, and increases further when a normal attack or skill hits an enemy. Acquires a damage reduction effect of 0-20% depending on the amount of fighting spirit. At maximum fighting spirit, attack speed increases by 30%. When you leave the battle state, fighting spirit is gradually converted to HP, recovering 70 (70 + 1.5% of additional HP) each time (up to 10 times).

skill1.name: Skill 1: Explosive attack
skill1.description: Charges in the specified direction, dealing 55 (55 + 15% of additional physical attack) physical damage to enemies along the route and knocking them up for 0.5 seconds. If you are a hero, you will deal collision damage equal to 5% of the target's maximum HP; if you are a non-hero, you will receive collision damage equal to 183 (5% of your maximum HP). Passive effect: The third normal attack becomes a heavy attack, dealing an additional 250 (250 + 100% of additional physical attack) physical damage.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Lava heavy attack
skill2.description: After charging on the spot, inject energy into the ground with your shield and gain a 400 (400 + 10% of additional HP) shield for 5 seconds. While charging, reduces the movement speed of enemies within range by 15% and draws non-hero enemy units towards the center. After 1 second, the ground explodes, dealing 350 (350 + 90% of additional physical attack) physical damage to enemies within the area. The closer you are to the center, the more damage the enemy takes, up to a maximum of 100% additional damage. If there is an enemy within skill range while charging, reset skill 1 CD. Other skills can be activated while skill 2 is activated.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Heaven and earth collapse
skill3.description: Jumps to the specified position and fires three blows towards the ground. The position of each hit can be adjusted using the direction keys. 1st time: Deals 220 (220 + 50% of additional physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range and reduces enemy movement speed by 15% for 1 second. Deals additional physical damage (60% of additional physical attack) to enemies in the center of the range. 2nd time: Deals 440 (440 + 100% of additional physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range and reduces enemy movement speed by 30% for 1 second. Deals additional physical damage (90% of additional physical attack) to enemies in the center of the range. 3rd time: Deals 660 (660 + 150% of additional physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range and knocks them up for 1 second. Deals collision damage equal to 10% of the target's maximum HP to heroes, and deals collision damage equal to 10% of the target's maximum HP to non-heroes. Deals additional physical damage (150% of additional physical attack) to enemies in the center of the area. Skill 1 can be activated while Skill 3 is activated.

strengths: Since you are always in super armor state while the skill is activated, your biggest strength is that you can forcefully launch a battle without being stopped by enemy CC. In addition, it has extremely high durability due to its fighting spirit system that reduces damage and recovers HP, and its skill 2 shield. It has multiple knock-ups and slows, and is excellent at disrupting enemy formations.
weaknesses: If there is no fighting spirit (such as immediately after the start of a battle), durability will not be fully demonstrated, so the immediate defense against surprise attacks will not be high. In addition, the animation of the skills is slow overall, especially the explosion of skill 2 and the third knock-up of skill 3, which take some time to occur, making it easy to avoid by highly mobile enemies.

passive.name: a soothing smile
passive.description: When your skill hits an enemy, your movement speed increases by 25%. Duration is 2 seconds.

skill1.name: flowers dancing wildly
skill1.description: Throws a fan in the specified direction. The fan returns like a boomerang and deals 550 (550 + 80% of magic attack power) magic damage to enemies in its orbit. Damage is reduced by 20% for each enemy hit, to a minimum of 40% of the initial damage.

skill2.name: whirlwind of love
skill2.description: Creates a whirlwind in the specified area, dealing 300 (300 + 50% of magic attack power) magic damage to enemies within the area and knocking them up for 1.5 seconds.

skill3.name: Seika no Ran
skill3.description: Summons meteors to continuously attack nearby enemies. Enemies hit by the meteor will receive 400 (400 + 100% of magic attack power) magic damage. A single skill activation can hit the same target up to 4 times, but the damage from the second hit onwards will be 50%. While the skill is active, your movement speed increases continuously (duration: 5 seconds, increase value is half of maximum speed).

106.status_text: Xiaoqiao Shokyou Breeze of Love Apprentice Mage 0/100 Mage Poke-type Mage Burst/Long Range Late Stage Difficulty: Easy

strategy.earlyGame: Use skill 1's fan, which has a long range, to deal with minions and keep enemy heroes in check from a safe position. If your skill hits an enemy, your movement speed increases passively, so the basic move is to accelerate immediately after throwing the fan and avoid the enemy's attack. Skill 2, Knockup, is a powerful self-defense tool, so don't use it blindly and save it for emergencies.
strategy.midGame: Utilizing its high mobility and range, it actively carries out surprise attacks on other lanes with its allies. The ``knock it up with skill 2 and deal round-trip damage with skill 1'' combo from the bushes will quickly reduce the enemy's HP. Skill 3 automatically damages enemies in a wide range just by activating it, and also increases your own movement speed, making it very useful in pursuit or escape situations.
strategy.lateGame: When equipped, the round-trip damage of skill 1's fan will be enough to drive the enemy's soft back-line heroes to the brink of death. In team fights, you just keep throwing Skill 1 and doing pokes to break the enemy's formation. By combining passive acceleration and skill 3 acceleration, you can run around the battlefield and fight while avoiding enemy skills.
strategy.teamfight: Continue to deal damage with skill 1 from behind your allies, and use skill 2 to knock up the enemy's carries and assassins to catch them. When the battle turns into a melee, activate skill 3 to sneak into the enemy camp and spread meteor damage over a wide area. It is powerful to use skill 3's automatic attack and passive acceleration to maintain a certain distance while avoiding enemy attacks.
strategy.commonMistakes: If you miss Skill 2 Whirlwind, which is your only self-defense/CC, or use it to deal with minions pointlessly, you will be defenseless against approaching assassins and will be easily defeated. Also, if you carelessly move too far forward to get an enemy into the range of skill 3, you will be defeated in an instant by the enemy's concentrated attack due to low durability, so be careful.

synergy.reason: Because it draws enemies to one place, it becomes easier to hit multiple people with her launch skill and ULT.
Because she can restrain the enemy's powerful assassins, she can create an environment where she in the rear can safely deal damage.

counters.reason: This is because you can quickly approach her from a distance and defeat her, who is vulnerable to attacks, before the skill combo.
Because she has a long-range stun attack, you can unilaterally interfere with her from a safe position.

strengths: Its strengths are its overwhelming long-range attack ability due to the long range and high firepower of skill 1, and its high mobility due to increased movement speed when hitting a skill or activating skill 3. As long as you can use direction-specific skill 1, you can always maintain an acceleration state and toy with the enemy. Skill 2, Knockup, occurs quickly and is an extremely excellent and powerful action inhibiting skill that can be used both offensively and defensively.
weaknesses: His own durability is extremely low, and although his movement speed is fast, he does not have teleportation skills, so he is extremely vulnerable if he is stopped by reliable CC such as targeted stuns. The damage of skill 1's fan decreases each time it hits multiple enemies, so be aware that if you have minions in between, you won't be able to deal maximum damage to the enemy hero in the back.

passive.name: dragon's roar
passive.description: Zhao Yun reduces incoming damage (5%/10%/20%) based on his current HP tier (70%/40%). If Zhao Yun receives healing that exceeds his max HP, the excess amount is converted into a permanent shield.

skill1.description: Dashes in the specified direction, dealing 350 (+120% extra Physical Attack) physical damage to enemies in his path. His next basic attack is enhanced, dealing 120 (+40% extra Physical Attack) extra physical damage and slowing the target's movement speed for 2 seconds. The dash distance increases with skill level (0-100). When his passive tier changes, this skill's charges are restored by 1.

skill2.name: Dragon of Clouds
skill2.description: Thrusts his spear rapidly 5 times in the specified direction, each hit dealing 200 (+65% extra Physical Attack) physical damage. Each hit restores 65 (+2.5% extra HP) HP. If consecutive hits strike the same target, damage and healing decay by 8% per hit (minimum 4%).

skill3.name: sky dragon
skill3.description: Leaps to the specified location, dealing 550 (+150% extra Physical Attack) physical damage to enemies in the area and knocking them up for 1 second. Marks enemies hit with "Shock" for 5 seconds, causing his skills to deal extra magical damage upon hitting them. If no enemy heroes are hit, 50% of the cooldown is refunded.

107.status_text: Zhao Yun Choun Sky Dragon Spear Apprentice Assassin 0/100 Assassin/Fighter Charge Assassin Mobility Early Difficulty: Normal

strategy.earlyGame: Close the distance with skill 1's charge and enhanced normal attacks, and earn experience points and money with a solid move that recovers HP while dealing damage with skill 2's continuous thrusts. The passive reduces the damage you receive as your HP decreases, so you can fight tenaciously even when your HP is somewhat low. There is no guaranteed CC until you acquire skill 3, so avoid unnecessary engagements.
strategy.midGame: Obtaining skill 3, Knock Up by Jump, will allow you to start a powerful battle. Let's attack the enemy with a combo of "diving in with skill 3, scrape with skill 2, and pursue with skill 1". Due to the enhanced state that is given after skill 3 hits, magic damage is added to the attack according to the target's maximum HP, so you can deal enough damage even against tank opponents.
strategy.lateGame: Fight tenaciously on the front lines by making use of the passive that gets harder as HP decreases and the recovery skill 2. If you enter a further strengthened state that activates when your HP is low, the percentage damage will be doubled, allowing you to unleash tremendous firepower and take revenge on the enemy even in a near-death situation. By accurately hitting multiple enemies with Skill 3, you can gain an advantage in group battles in the final stages.
strategy.teamfight: Attack the enemy's gap and use skill 3 to jump directly into the rear mage or marksman and knock them up. Due to the damage reduction effect of the passive, you can barely survive even if you are hit by a concentrated attack in the middle of the enemy line. When your HP is low, use Skill 2 to recover it, and use the mobility of Skill 1 to escape from the front line or pursue the remaining enemies.
strategy.commonMistakes: If you rely too much on passive damage reduction and jump into a position where you receive a barrage of attacks that your recovery cannot keep up with, you will be defeated easily. Also, if you remove Skill 3, which is the starting point for the combo, you will not be able to approach the enemy and will not be able to receive damage based on the strengthened state, resulting in a sharp decrease in firepower. You should also avoid using Skill 1 as just damage and losing the means to escape.

synergy.reason: This is because he can annihilate enemies at once with powerful magic burst damage when launched with his ULT.
Because his shield and recovery greatly increase his survivability after diving into enemy territory.

counters.reason: Their powerful suppression skills completely block their mobility, leaving them exposed to concentrated fire.
Continuous stuns and shields will prevent him from approaching, and his skills will also prevent him from leaving.

strengths: His greatest strength is his ``amazing tenacity even in a near-death state'' due to his passive, which reduces the damage he takes as his HP decreases. Combined with skill 2's recovery, he has the ability to win in last-minute battles. Skill 3 allows you to jump in from a long distance and knock it up, and with the additional effect of percentage magic damage, it is also powerful to be able to deliver stable firepower regardless of the target.
weaknesses: Most of its attacks rely on physical damage at close range, so it is vulnerable to CC such as slows and stuns that prevent it from approaching, and it is extremely difficult to recover when skill 3 is missed. Due to the nature of the passive, it cannot demonstrate its true strength unless its HP is reduced to a certain extent, so it is weak against overwhelming instantaneous burst damage that can quickly cut it off from its maximum HP.

108.status_text: Sumiko I Sage of Peace Apprentice Mage 0/100 Mage/Fighter CC type Mage CC/Shield Late stage Difficulty: Hard

strategy.earlyGame: In the early stages, use your passive shield and skill 2's long-range fire to deal with minions and harass enemies from a safe position. Since you can obtain a shield each time you activate a skill, you can steadily progress in lane battles while reducing damage taken. Knockback from enhanced normal attacks is also useful as a deterrent.
strategy.midGame: In the middle stages, use the stun effect of skill 2 and continuous damage from the field to assist in killing allies and poke in object battles. A powerful combo is to adjust your position with skill 1's rush, land a strengthened normal attack, and connect to skill 2. A strategy that maintains the shield and increases the ability to continue fighting is required.
strategy.lateGame: 終盤は装備が揃い、スキル2の魔法ダメージとスタンが敵の脅威となります。集団戦の前に遠距離からポークして敵のHPを削りましょう。敵のキャリーにスキル2を当ててスタンさせることができれば、一気に有利な展開を作れます。不用意に前に出ず、射程を活かした立ち回りを徹底してください。
strategy.teamfight: In group battles, skill 2 uses a long-range stun to break up enemy formations, while skill 3 deploys an energy barrier to stun enemies in a wide area when the enemy approaches your allies. By charging with Skill 1 and using Skill 3 in the middle of the enemy's formation, you can restrain multiple enemies for a long time and create an environment where your allies can easily deal damage.
strategy.commonMistakes: A common mistake is overestimating your durability and rushing into enemy territory alone, missing skill 3 and getting hit by a barrage of fire. Also, if the accuracy of skill 2 is low, the contribution to the team will be greatly reduced. Even though he has a passive shield, he is a magician, so you need to be careful when he is vulnerable while his skills are on cooldown.

synergy.reason: Because it gathers enemies in one place, it becomes easier to trap multiple enemies in the ULT barrier at the same time.
He is excellent at supporting allies and inhibiting enemy actions, and can increase the accuracy of his long-range stuns.

counters.reason: Because his ULT chant can be easily interrupted by wide range CC or skill reset.
Because he charges directly into the rear guard, his strength in being good at pokes from a long distance is destroyed.

strengths: The biggest strength is that all skills have hard CC (knockback, stun). In particular, skill 2 allows him to safely inflict stuns from a distance, and his passive shield allows him to have high durability even though he is a magician. He has a very good balance between attack, defense, and CC, and is excellent at supporting his allies.
weaknesses: The weak points are that skill 2 is linear and easy to avoid once you get used to the bullet speed, and skill 3 also prevents you from moving while it is deployed, so it is easy to be interrupted by long-range attacks or CC. Also, since it is highly dependent on magic attack power, it tends to lack firepower until it has all the equipment, and there is also a drawback that there is a large gap when skills are missed.

strategy.lateGame: In the second half of the battle, it boasts overwhelming firepower that can kill enemy mages and marksmen with a single combo. You will be required to maneuver like an assassin, sharing the view of the map with your allies and aiming for surprise attacks from enemy blind spots and bushes. If you can reduce the number of enemies by one before a teamfight, it will be a huge contribution to your team that will decide the match.
strategy.teamfight: He is extremely vulnerable to being hit, and once he uses his skills, he will be unable to do anything during the cooldown period, so charging head-on is strictly prohibited. In group fights, take a position at the back and use skill 2 to stun the enemy assassins who are targeting your allies to protect yourself, or take advantage of the melee and hit the enemy's soft rear hero with a full combo to quickly escape.
strategy.commonMistakes: If you use all your skills against an enemy with high HP or magic defense, such as an enemy tank or fighter, you will not be able to defeat them and will be defeated by a counterattack. Also, skill 3, Foxfire, will fly to random enemies within range, so if you activate it in a crowd of minions, the damage will be spread out, leading to the fatal mistake of failing to defeat the enemy hero.

synergy.reason: Along with Daki's reliable single-target stun, Son Goku's high firepower can instantly burst kill the enemy.
This is because it is easy to connect the enemy's physical strength that Daki has reduced to consecutive kills by taking advantage of Assassin's skill reset.

This is because before you can fire a skill, you will be attacked by stealth and Daki, who has no durability, will die instantly.

strengths: Skill 2 is a targeted stun, so its biggest strength is that it is extremely easy to operate and can definitely stop the enemy in its tracks. In addition, the magic defense reduction effect of his passive and skill 3's consecutive hits are strongly combined, and his burst damage against a single target when equipped is top class among all heroes. Surprise tactics using bushes are powerful.
weaknesses: Since her skills are biased toward single-target attacks, and skill 3 is a random target, she is extremely bad at group fights and dealing with minions against multiple enemies at the same time. Also, since it does not have movement skills, its mobility is low, and once an enemy approaches it, there is no way to escape other than to stun with skill 2. There is also a huge gap after you have exhausted all your skills.

A powerful hit-and-away tactic is to apply continuous damage and slow the enemy with skill 1's wings, and use skill 2's shield and movement speed increase to pull them to a safe distance when they are about to receive a counterattack.

In small battles, use Skill 1 to gain footholds in areas where enemies are concentrated, and use piercing normal attacks to damage multiple people. Skill 3 allows you to move freely while firing long-range, continuous damage forward, so use your firepower while blocking the enemy's escape route.

When an enemy assassin or fighter approaches you, you can reactivate Skill 3 and release wings around you, giving it a fear effect and nullifying physical attack bonuses, allowing you to perform powerful self-defense and counterattacks.

When the battle intensifies, skill 3 will be activated and a large number of feather arrows will cause great damage in a wide area. Ideally, you should reactivate skill 3 (fear + physical weakening) the moment the enemy jumps in, neutralize the enemy's attack, and take a counterattack.

To restrain enemies with a wide range of CC and make it easier to hit multiple enemies with Karla's ultimate, which has a large opening.

This is because their high mobility quickly closes the gap and prevents them from being able to check from a distance, which is their specialty.

In addition, it has extremely powerful self-defense and debuff abilities such as wide-ranging "fear" and "nullification of physical attack bonus" by reactivating skill 3, and has extremely strong resistance against physical assassins and fighters.
weaknesses: It doesn't have hard CC that can definitely stop them, and its only CC, fear, is conditional on reactivating skill 3 (abandoning main firepower), so it's not good at actively capturing enemies. Also, since he does not have the teleportation skill, he cannot escape by using the terrain such as over walls, and is vulnerable to slow attacks that block his high movement speed and a barrage of guaranteed CC attacks.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early stages, skill 1 rolls to extend the range and strengthen normal attacks, putting pressure on the enemy from a safe distance. Normal attacks reduce the cooldown of Skill 1, so increase the turnover rate of Skill 1 while attacking minions. Movement speed increases after rolling, so make sure to hit and away.
strategy.midGame: In the middle stage, firepower will be generated starting from skill 2 bombs. If Skill 2 hits, the enemy's physical defense will be reduced and normal attacks against the stamped enemy will deal additional damage. It is possible to reduce HP at once with the combo "Skill 1 → Skill 2 → Enhanced Normal Attack". Take advantage of your mobility in small-scale battles in jungles and rivers.
strategy.lateGame: In the final stage, you will be able to deal extremely high physical damage. In group battles, position yourself at the rear, use Skill 1 to adjust your position, and use enhanced normal attacks to ensure you are cutting through the enemy's front line. Skill 3, Long Range Ballista, is perfect for dealing damage to enemies in a wide range as a final blow to fleeing enemies, or as a poke before the start of battle.
strategy.teamfight: In group battles, it is important to keep an appropriate distance using skill 1 roll to avoid being caught by enemy assassins or fighters. From behind the vanguard, use skill 2 to lower the enemy's defense and repeatedly attack with enhanced normal attacks to deal damage. Use the passive effect that increases your movement speed when there are enemies nearby, and keep attacking while always moving.
strategy.commonMistakes: A common mistake is to use skill 1 to roll forward towards the enemy line and be defeated instantly. Use rolling to escape or adjust position, and use aggressive rolling only when it is safe to do so. Also, if you remove skill 2, the firepower will be significantly reduced, so if you don't throw properly and don't have the awareness to hit the target properly, you won't be able to succeed.

synergy.reason: This is because she can restrain the enemy with strong CC and create an opening for her to inflict burst damage from a safe position.
This is because she can force group battles with a wide range of launches and create an environment where she can move freely and defeat enemies individually.

counters.reason: This is because her mobility will be completely nullified with a guaranteed hard CC, and she will be defeated without giving her a chance to escape.
This is because you can use a long-range stun to stop her movement and prevent her from hitting and away, which is her specialty.

strengths: Its greatest strengths are its overwhelming instantaneous firepower and its high mobility and long range thanks to Skill 1. Skill 2's defense reduction effect can deal great damage even to hard tanks, and Skill 3's long range attacks are also powerful. The continuous firepower is also excellent because the skill turnover rate increases by interposing normal attacks.
weaknesses: Its weakness is that it does not have CC skills and its own durability is very low, so once you are caught, you will be defeated without being able to do anything. Also, since the main damage source relies on normal attacks and skill 1, it is vulnerable to attack speed reduction and blindness effects, and if its mobility is blocked, it will be at a disadvantage. Mistakes in positioning can lead to instant death.

strategy.earlyGame: Lane battles are centered around passive strafing, which deals damage based on your maximum HP. A powerful technique is to perform four normal attacks with a whiff, then use the fifth one to sweep and hit the enemy hero. Use skill 1's bomb to give slowness, and make sure to hit the enhanced normal attack (strafe) after skill activation to win the damage trade. Always be on guard against surprise attacks.
strategy.midGame: As your equipment increases and your attack power increases, the damage per maximum HP ratio of strafing becomes more brutal. Skill 2's rockets reach the entire map, allowing you to pick off fleeing enemies in far lanes and score kills. It is important to use Skill 2's short-range knockback to push away approaching enemies, and then immediately attack them with a sweeping attack.
strategy.lateGame: As a fixed artillery battery boasting overwhelming firepower, it is the source of damage in group battles. Deploys an airship with skill 3 to ensure continuous area damage and visibility, and fires a series of strafing shots from behind it while sandwiching the skill. Even if it's an enemy tank, you can instantly melt it with damage equal to its maximum HP, so the most important thing is to keep attacking without dying.
strategy.teamfight: Attack from the safety of the last position, fully protected by allied tanks and supports. Maximize your firepower by using Skills 1, 2, and 3 in order, with a passive sweep in between. If an enemy Assassin approaches from behind, calmly use skill 2 to knock him back, then use the tremendous firepower of his sweep to defend himself.
strategy.commonMistakes: The most common mistakes are moving too far forward and getting caught by enemy CC, or being isolated and becoming a target for assassins. Also, since you cannot move from the spot while strafing, it is dangerous to straf at the timing when you should be avoiding enemy skills and get hit. You should also avoid using skill 2 to shoot far away and creating a situation where there is no knockback for self-defense.

synergy.reason: Because his strong control creates an environment where he can safely deal damage.
This is because his ability to maintain the front line is high, and he creates space that makes it easy for him in the back to attack.

counters.reason: Because of their high mobility and burst damage, they can ignore the vanguard and be defeated directly.
Because he has a skill that nullifies physical damage, he is at a disadvantage when trading damage in lane battles.

strengths: Its greatest strength is its passive ``strafe'', which can be issued immediately after the skill is activated, and deals physical damage in proportion to the target's maximum HP. This gives it one of the best carrying abilities that can easily cut through even hard tanks. Skill 2 allows long-range sniping, which allows you to aim at the entire map, and Skill 3, the airship, allows you to secure a wide range of visibility.
weaknesses: Since it does not have any instantaneous movement skills or movement speed increase skills, its mobility is extremely low and it has no escape ability. The only means of self-defense is skill 2, short-range knockback, and if you are attacked by multiple enemies, you will be defeated without being able to do anything. It also has the weakness of being easily targeted by enemy direction designation skills and long-range attacks because it stops moving even during powerful strafing attacks.

strategy.midGame: From the middle of the game, you will work together with your allies, and use skill 2 to increase movement speed and damage stacks to gain an advantage in small battles. Skill 2 gives stacks to yourself and your allies, and up to 5 stacks will give you a high movement speed buff, making it very powerful in pursuit and retreat. Let's take into consideration the automatic activation of passives.

Skill 1's wide range slow restricts enemy movement, skill 2 increases the mobility of allies, and passive and skill 3's CC nullification control the board.

It is effective to get behind the enemy and use a rushing attack to push the enemy towards your allies' base. Save skill 2 to remove CC and go on a rampage while nullifying enemy interference.

Protected by shields and CC, you can safely enter and leave enemy lines.

strengths: Its greatest strength is its overwhelming mobility due to its passive, and its powerful knockback and damage based on its maximum HP when charging. He has a skill that allows him to remove CC on his own, and when skill 3 is activated, he can continuously push the enemy away, so his formation destruction ability and surprise attack performance are extremely high.
weaknesses: It is very difficult to operate because you have to keep moving all the time. It has a clear weakness: it is vulnerable to strong slow effects that remove it from its charging state, it is vulnerable to continuous CC (movement interference), and once it is stopped, there is a high risk of being defeated by a barrage of fire before it can resume its charging state.

If the flower ball hits, the cooldown of skill 2 will be shortened, so in combination with the explosion of the mark (recovery/guaranteed damage), you can persistently continue to deal damage in small-group battles.
strategy.lateGame: In the final stage, you will deploy a skill 3 formation, and by fighting within it, you will demonstrate an overwhelming skill turnover rate. Skills 1 and 2 can be used continuously in the formation, so with the range-based damage caused by the seal's explosion and continuous recovery, it is possible to fight against multiple enemies without being defeated.
strategy.teamfight: Deploy a formation with skill 3, and use skill 2 invincibility (instantaneous movement) within the range of the formation to avoid the enemy's skills and chain the explosion of the seal. By spreading true damage and slowing to all surrounding enemies and continuing to recover your own HP, you can act as a damage source and hate target in group battles.
strategy.commonMistakes: If you fail to hit the enemy with the flower ball of skill 2, the cooldown will not be reduced, and your mobility and firepower will be interrupted, exposing a fatal gap. Also, if you go outside of the skill 3 group, your skill turnover rate will not increase and you will not be able to demonstrate your true strengths. It is also strictly prohibited to stop the combo due to the enemy's heavy CC (movement interference).

synergy.reason: By canceling the range CC, you can continue dancing within the ultimate without stopping.
Because you can gather enemies with a powerful area provocation and maximize the area damage of your ultimate.

counters.reason: This is because the movement can be completely blocked by a suppressing skill (Ultimate) that cannot be canceled even by purification.
Due to its high instantaneous firepower and silence, there is a high risk of being defeated before you can use your skills.

strengths: The loop of "definite damage", "HP recovery" and "slow" caused by the passive seal explosion is very powerful. With skill 2's ability to evade through instantaneous movement and skill 3's overwhelming skill rotation rate within the formation, if the operation accuracy is high, it has the potential to annihilate multiple enemies while avoiding all enemy attacks.
weaknesses: Since you need to keep repeating skill combos, if you get caught by hard CC such as silence or stun, you will be defeated without being able to do anything. Also, even though it has guaranteed damage, its durability itself is low, so its major weakness is that it can be defeated by instantaneous high firepower (burst damage) before recovery can catch up.

Your role is to securely restrain the enemy's troublesome assassins and carries, and focus and drop them together with your allies. Also, it is inefficient to stack skill 1's barrier without understanding that the stun will not stack even if you hit the same enemy multiple times. strategy.midGame: Understand the modes that change by switching weapons (protection, attack, super kill). strategy.teamfight: Extend your weapon's range with regular attacks and start attacking from a safe rear position. counters.reason: Because it has high durability and interference skills, it is easy to be defeated by damage trade.

strengths: Its biggest strengths are its ability to perform normal attacks while moving when skill 3 is activated, and its overwhelming continuous firepower due to increased attack speed that has no upper limit. weaknesses: You cannot switch weapons at will, and you can only progress through the stages by hitting normal attacks, so right after the battle starts (especially when the weapon is short), the short range makes it easy to counterattack. Also, always be aware of the CD reduction with skill 1's enhanced normal attack, and contribute to the battle while maintaining a high skill turnover rate.
strategy.lateGame: In the final battle, Skill 3's invincibility time and wide range recovery/damage will be a very powerful weapon. Their biggest role is to avoid the enemy's powerful CC and burst damage with skill 3, while significantly recovering nearby allies and maintaining the front line. Also, it is important to use skill 2 to stun to capture enemy carries and protect allies. strategy.teamfight: In team battles, the difference between victory and defeat is how you switch passives according to the situation and how you use Skill 3. When an ally's HP is low, use Seihei to recover it, and the moment an enemy's powerful attack or CC hits you, use skill 3 to become untargetable and recover your ally while removing CC. Provide continuous support and hindrance by constantly firing Skill 1 and continuing to shorten the CD with enhanced normal attacks.
strategy.commonMistakes: A common mistake is forgetting to switch passive skills. counters.reason: Due to their overwhelming mobility, they were able to quickly close the distance, and Yang Guifei was defeated before she could recover her allies.

Another strong advantage is that the skill turnover rate is high due to the CD reduction effect of skill 1, and the versatility of skill 2's movement speed increase and pursuit/escape with stun.
weaknesses: While it can provide both recovery and damage, its instantaneous burst damage is modest, and it lacks the ability to quickly defeat enemies on its own. Also, skill 2 has a 1.5 second lag when activating the stun, so it is easy to avoid by highly mobile enemies, making it somewhat unstable as a reliable CC. Since your ability to survive while Skill 3 is on cooldown depends on the increase in movement speed of Skill 2, you will be extremely vulnerable if approached by enemy assassins without Skill 3.

Also, even if you have super armor when moving around with skill 3, your movement trajectory is easy to read, so it would be a fatal mistake to jump defenselessly into a spot where the enemy's powerful burst damage is concentrated.

synergy.reason: By providing a movement speed buff, it supplements Monki's mobility and allows him to quickly rush into enemy territory.
Because it provides a shield and huge CC, and creates an environment where Monki can rampage for a long time on the front lines of teamfights.

counters.reason: With silence and burst damage, you can cut down on Monki all at once before he activates his skills.
This is because it can remove the CC of all allies, completely nullifying Monki's engagement and interfering abilities.

strengths: Due to its overwhelming physical attack power and raised defense power due to its increased mass, it boasts extremely high stats in both offense and defense. weaknesses: When you enter combat, your mass decreases little by little, and when you leave combat, you lose it rapidly, making it difficult to maintain mass at all times. Also, while skill damage depends on magical attacks, the benefits of mass are biased toward physical attacks, making it difficult to choose a build and being extremely weak when attacked by mobile enemies.

skill1.description:
Create a paradise for animals by growing plants. The attack speed and movement speed of Mountain Child and allied monsters will be increased by 15%, HP will be recovered by 40 (40 + 0.6% of additional maximum HP), and allied monsters will come to the paradise and fight together. The status of companion monsters increases with hero level, and the probability of summoning multiple monsters increases with skill level.
50% of the mountain child's status is reflected in the attack power, attack speed, and critical rate of allied monsters.

skill2.name: Roll! Ponpon!
skill2.description:
"Roll! Pon-Pon!": Move forward while rolling with the Pon-Pon (disable hard CC once). While spinning, gain 40 damage block, deal 240 (240 + 80% of additional physical attack) physical damage to hit enemies, and stun them for 1/2 second. If you hit a wall during the effect period, you will bounce (up to 3 times) and the rotation distance will be reset, the skill effect will increase by 25%, and your next normal attack will be strengthened. Enhanced normal attack releases 3 seed bombs in succession, dealing an additional 60 (60 + 20% of additional physical attack) physical damage.
"Roll! Agudo!": The mountain child rolls forward and strengthens his next normal attack. Enhanced normal attack releases 3 seed bombs in succession, dealing an additional 60 (60 + 20% of additional physical attack) physical damage.

skill3.name: gorge gathering
skill3.description:
Mounted: Pom Pom moves away from the mountain child and jumps to the specified location, dealing 460 (460 + 150% of additional physical attack) physical damage and stunning her for 2/3 seconds. After that, Pom Pom will act alone (50% of Mountain Child's status and 100% of normal attack effect will be reflected).
Separated state: Pom Pom enters recovery mode when defeated. Returns to battle when HP reaches maximum. While Pom Pom is alive, it can be recalled by reactivating it.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early stages, use passive effects to get close to jungle monsters and let them escape, gaining buffs and quickly farming. Pick up the seed bombs that are dropped by normal attacks to increase your movement speed and attack speed to increase your jungle traversal efficiency. When going for a gank in lane, use skill 2, Pom Pom, and a rolling rush to hit and stun enemies, while also gaining damage with the seed bomb of the enhanced basic attack.
strategy.midGame: In the middle stage, you fight by releasing the power of the monsters you have collected. Use Skill 1 to grow plants and summon fellow monsters to gain advantage in tower pushes and group battles with your allies. Within the range of Skill 1, your own attack speed and movement speed will increase, and your HP will also recover, making you extremely powerful in battles in your position. By aiming for skill 2's bounce using walls, you can also perform technical surprise attacks that utilize stun and damage amplification.
strategy.lateGame: In the final stage, he acts together with his allies, acting as a support and tank that increases the overall combat power of the team with range buffs and monster summons from skill 1. It is important to initiate skill 3 to activate the enemy's carry formation, have PomPon jump to the specified position, stun and deal heavy damage, and break the formation. While Pom Pom is fighting alone, it is vulnerable in its mountain child state, so support it with seed bombs from a safe position.
strategy.teamfight: In group battles, skill 1 gives powerful buffs and recovery to allies and fellow monsters, and its biggest role is to dominate the battlefield. Use skill 3 to charge Pom Pom into areas where there are a lot of enemies, inflicting an area stun and starting the battle. Skill 2 can disable hard CC once, so you can disturb the enemy's formation while getting out of the enemy's interference. Pay close attention to the position of the mountain child that is separating from Pom Pom.
strategy.commonMistakes: After separating Pom Pom with skill 3, the durability of a single mountain child is very low, and a common mistake is that if it moves too far forward, it will be destroyed in an instant. Also, you need to be careful about operational mistakes such as hitting a wall during skill 2 and bouncing in an unintended direction, failing to stun the enemy, or being left deep behind enemy lines. If you let monsters escape and fight without accumulating buffs, you will not be able to demonstrate your true power.

synergy.reason: Continuous recovery greatly increases the ability to continue fighting both when mounted and not mounted.
It provides a strong front line and shield, allowing the main body to continue delivering firepower from a safe distance.

counters.reason: Due to its extremely high mobility, it is easy to destroy the jungle and hinder your farm in the early stages.
This is because they are targeted when they are defenseless when they dismount, and it is difficult to escape due to their high pursuit ability.

strengths: A unique system that lets monsters escape without killing them allows you to travel around the jungle in a safe and special way. Skill 1 provides powerful range buffs and recovery to allies, and by summoning many monsters to fight together, he has extremely good pushing power and control power in group battles. Pom Pom's ranged stun from a long distance with skill 3 is a powerful initiation method, and it also has the mobility and sabotage ability due to skill 2's CC immunity and bounce.
weaknesses: After separating Pom Pom with skill 3, the mountain child (main body) has low stats and has a weak point that makes it vulnerable to being targeted by assassins. If Pom Pom is defeated, it will take some time for it to return to battle, and during that time its strength will be significantly reduced. Also, if you haven't collected enough jungle monsters, the benefit of skill 1 will be weak, and if you control the pace of the match and invade the enemy's jungle, it will be difficult to recover.

passive.name: Guardian of Fireflies
passive.description:
When you deal damage with a normal attack, a firefly will be summoned, dealing 100 (100 + 20% of magic attack + 3% of additional maximum HP) magic damage to the enemy and inflicting stealth immunity for 3 seconds. At regular intervals, recovers 60 HP (60 + 10% of magic attack + 1.5% of additional maximum HP) of the nearby ally hero with the lowest HP.
If there are no enemies nearby, charging a normal attack will restore 60 HP (60 + 10% of magic attack + 1.5% of additional maximum HP), but HP recovery of allies will be interrupted.

skill1.name: The power of kuwagi
skill1.description:
Channels the "power of fireflies" into the specified area, dealing 500 (500 + 10% of magic attack) magic damage to enemies within the area and knocking them up for 1 second. Hitting an enemy consumes Firefly's power and deals 100 (100 + 20% of magic attack + 3% of additional maximum HP) magic damage for each stack of Firefly's power.
If there are friendly heroes nearby, consume Firefly's Power and heal the lowest HP of the friendly hero by 60 (60 + 10% of magic attack + 1.5% of additional maximum HP) for each stack of Firefly's Power.
"Power of Firefly": You can obtain 1 stack of Firefly's power every 1.5 seconds (up to 9 stacks). The skill range expands according to the number of stacks.

skill2.name: Wind riding
skill2.description:
Fly to the selected bush, obtain 1 stack of "Firefly Power", and summon 1 firefly every time you fly a certain distance. After 1 second, the fireflies fly towards the hero with the lowest HP, dealing 100 (100 + 20% of magic attack + 3% of additional maximum HP) magic damage to the enemy and inflicting stealth immunity for 3 seconds, or healing allied heroes by 60 (60 + 10% of magic attack + 1.5% of additional maximum HP) HP.
This skill can be charged 3 times, and when tapped, it flies towards the selected bush.

skill3.name: faint fireflies
skill3.description:
Summons a "bush of light" to the specified location. If activated again within 6 seconds, it will fly to the summoned bush and receive 1 stack of Firefly Power.
“Thicket of Light”: 1 second after summoning the Thicket of Light, it releases fireflies every second towards 5 nearby heroes. Each firefly deals 100 (100 + 20% of magic attack + 3% of additional maximum HP) magic damage or restores 60 (60 + 10% of magic attack + 1.5% of additional maximum HP) HP to an ally hero. When an enemy unit enters a bush of light, it gains vision of that hero. Fireflies caused by bushes of light will no longer appear when they are about to disappear. After the light bush disappears, it becomes a normal bush for 30 seconds.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early stages, you can utilize the passive effect of summoning fireflies to gain an advantage in lane battles while dealing magic damage to enemies, harassing them by nullifying stealth, and restoring HP of allies. When there are no enemies around, charge your normal attacks to recover your HP and maintain your durability. If you keep in mind the stack of "Fireflies Power" that accumulates every 1.5 seconds, and fire Skill 1 while the stack is high, you will be able to knock up and deal large damage over a wide area.
strategy.midGame: In the middle stages, you will use Skill 2 to fly around the bushes and move around the map with high mobility while supporting your allies and searching for enemies. Skill 2 allows Fireflies to automatically attack enemies, break stealth, or heal allies when moving through the bushes, making it very powerful in small battles. In preparation for battles in areas with no bushes, use skill 3 to summon a "bush of light" and control the area with ranged damage and recovery from continuous firing of fireflies.
strategy.lateGame: In the final stage, the knock-up by wide-range skill 1, which has the "Power of Firefly" accumulated to the maximum, becomes an important CC (action obstruction) that determines the outcome of the team battle. Against the enemy's stealth assassin, you will be required to use your passive or skill to disable stealth for 3 seconds with a firefly attack and protect your allies in the rear guard. Place skill 3, "Thicket of Light," near the enemy's march route or objects to ensure visibility and provide continuous support.
strategy.teamfight: In team battles, it's ideal to knock up multiple enemies with stacked Skill 1 and aim for initiation or counter, while at the same time recovering a large amount of HP of your allies. Place skill 3 in the center of the battlefield and emit fireflies every second to 5 heroes around you to continuously support the entire front. Use Skill 2 to fly around the bushes and summoned light bushes on the battlefield, avoiding enemy attacks and always maintaining an advantageous position.
strategy.commonMistakes: Skill 1's range and additional effects (damage and recovery) are determined by the number of stacks of "Power of Fireflies", so it is a common mistake to activate it in haste without stacks accumulated, which weakens the benefits. Also, while charging a normal attack in a place where there are no enemies to recover your own HP, the recovery of HP to your allies will be interrupted, so if you abandon your allies during battle and prioritize your own recovery, you will lose the team fight.

synergy.reason: Continuous recovery and protection can greatly increase the survival rate against high-firepower marksmen with low mobility.
Against tanks that continue to fight on the front lines, its high recovery power can raise its practical durability to the maximum.

counters.reason: His movement was blocked by a powerful restraint skill, and he was unable to make use of his mobility to escape by flying over a wall.
Due to the high burst damage, there is a risk of being killed instantly before you can use recovery or escape skills.

strengths: His strength is his extremely versatile support ability, which can heal allies, damage enemies, knock up enemies, and even nullify stealth and secure visibility. Passive and skill fireflies automatically track the target, allowing for stable support. With the ability to move between bushes with Skill 2 and the summoning of bushes with Skill 3, it has extremely high mobility and survival ability that utilizes the terrain of the map, and has area domination in local battles.
weaknesses: In order to maximize the effect of the main skill 1, it is necessary to accumulate stacks of "Firefly Power" over time, and it is not possible to fire powerful skills continuously. Also, because some of his mobility and support abilities depend on "thickets," skill 3 is on cooldown and he is not good at fighting in open areas with no surrounding bushes. It is weak against instantaneous burst damage and powerful hard CC, and its weakness is that it is highly dependent on allies.

passive.name: splash gradient
passive.description:
All skills are considered starting skills. When you hit an enemy with any skill, the next skill you fire will be strengthened as an additional move, and you will receive 1 stack of Engraving for 4 seconds (up to 5 stacks).
When stacked 3 times, the next normal attack will be strengthened to the additional technique "Splash Gradation". Charges towards the enemy and attacks 7 times, dealing 121 (80 + 25% of physical attack) physical damage each time and reducing the enemy's movement speed by 10%. The final damage deals physical damage equal to 12% of the target's missing maximum HP. Gain a 21% to 35% damage reduction effect while using enhanced normal attacks.
The additional skill inflicts a disabling effect on the enemy hit, and each stack reduces the enemy's attack speed by 10% to 20% for 4 seconds (maximum 2 stacks). Enemies remove one stack of disabling effects each time they perform a normal attack.

skill1.name: try slash
skill1.description: Starting technique: Fires a try slash in the specified direction, and after a certain period of time, deals 366 (200 + 100% of physical attack) physical damage to enemies along the route. When Trislash hits an enemy, Rose Swordsman's movement speed increases by 80%. This effect reverts over 2 seconds.

forms.description: Starting technique: Fires a try slash in the specified direction, and after a certain period of time, deals 366 (200 + 100% of physical attack) physical damage to enemies along the route. When Trislash hits an enemy, Rose Swordsman's movement speed increases by 80%. This effect reverts over 2 seconds.

Additional technique: Rapidly fires a try slash in the specified direction, and after a shorter time lag than the starting technique, deals 475 (260 + 130% of physical attack) physical damage to enemies along the route. When Trislash hits an enemy, Rose Swordsman's movement speed increases by 80%. This effect reverts over 2 seconds.

skill2.name: splash fant
skill2.description: Starting technique: Rush in the specified direction and quickly stab 6 times. Deals 69 (45 + 15% of physical attack) physical damage to the enemy hit each time, and recovers own HP by 70 (70 + 1% of additional maximum HP).

forms.description: Starting technique: Rush in the specified direction and quickly stab 6 times. Deals 69 (45 + 15% of physical attack) physical damage to the enemy hit each time, and recovers own HP by 70 (70 + 1% of additional maximum HP).

Additional skill: Rush in the specified direction and quickly stab 6 times. Deals 69 (45 + 15% of physical attack) physical damage to the enemy hit each time, and restores own maximum HP by 70 (70 + 1% of maximum HP). CD is shorter than the starting move.

skill3.name: power gradation
skill3.description:
Starting technique: Draws 7 sword marks on the spot and attacks nearby enemies up to 3 times, dealing 320 (320 + 75% of additional physical attack) physical damage each time and reducing movement speed by 25% for 1 second. While the skill is active, you will gain super armor status and a passive effect that reduces damage taken.
If you damage an enemy multiple times, the damage from the second time onwards will be reduced to 30%.

forms.description:
Starting technique: Draws 7 sword marks on the spot and attacks nearby enemies up to 3 times, dealing 320 (320 + 75% of additional physical attack) physical damage each time and reducing movement speed by 25% for 1 second. While the skill is active, you will gain super armor status and a passive effect that reduces damage taken.
If you damage an enemy multiple times, the damage from the second time onwards will be reduced to 30%.

Additional technique: Quickly draws 7 sword marks on the spot (skill activation speed is faster than the starting technique), attacks nearby enemies up to 3 times, deals 320 (320 + 75% of physical attack) physical damage each time, and reduces movement speed by 25% for 1 second.
If you damage an enemy multiple times, the damage from the second time onwards will be reduced to 30%.
After completing the sword formation, activate "Power Gradation" and deal the same amount of damage again to the enemy in the center of the sword mark, knocking them up for 0.75 seconds. While the skill is active, you will gain super armor status and a passive effect that reduces damage taken.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early stages, use Skill 1's long-range attacks to keep the enemy in check, and use the 80% increase in movement speed when hit to maintain a safe position. Be aware of applying skills to enemies to release "additional skills" and accumulate passive stamp stacks. The basic strategy is to use skill 2's charge and recovery to gain an advantage in damage trading in the lane, and then deal damage all at once with the enhanced normal attack "Splash Gradation" when 3 stacks are accumulated.
strategy.midGame: In the middle of the game, Charlotte's true value will be revealed as cooldown reduction equipment begins to be available and the skill turnover rate increases. Always maintain "additional skills" by hitting the skill continuously, give the enemy a disabling effect that reduces attack speed, and dominate the fight with physical attackers. While using enhanced normal attacks, you will receive a damage reduction effect, so in combination with skill 3, Super Armor, you can withstand enemy CC (movement interference) and burst damage.
strategy.lateGame: In team battles in the final stages, you can take advantage of your high durability and sustained firepower to cut deep into enemy lines and relentlessly hunt down enemy marksmen and mages. Use skills and enhanced normal attacks without interruption to ensure a kill with additional damage based on the target's missing HP. Even when the enemy focuses on you, your role is to maintain the front line by showing amazing tenacity with enhanced normal attacks, reducing damage with skill 3, and recovering with skill 2.
strategy.teamfight: In team battles, it's ideal to apply skills to minions and jungle monsters in advance to accumulate engraving stacks, and then enter the battle with the ability to immediately use enhanced normal attacks. Charges into the enemy formation with Skill 2, stops them with the wide-area damage and movement speed reduction of Skill 3, and hits them with 7 consecutive enhanced normal attacks. It is important to apply attack speed reduction debuffs to enemy carries with additional techniques to significantly reduce their damage output.
strategy.commonMistakes: If you fail to hit the enemy with your skill and end up with the "starting move," your firepower will be drastically reduced because you won't be able to accumulate passive stamps and be unable to use enhanced normal attacks. Also, if you rush into the enemy line defenselessly without enhanced normal attacks, skill 3 damage reduction, or super armor, you will often make the mistake of being defeated in no time. It is also dangerous to not manage the stack of wound effects and attack the enemy head-on without being able to reduce their attack speed.

synergy.reason: It restrains the enemy with powerful CC, making it easy to stack passives and connect combos.
By gathering multiple enemies in one place, you can maximize area damage and recovery effects.

counters.reason: Silence forces skill combos to be interrupted and prevents stacking of passives.
Due to its high mobility and kite ability, it does not allow you to get close, and you can only deal damage from a distance.

strengths: Its biggest strengths are its flowing continuous attacks that start with a skill hit, and its enhanced normal attack "Splash Gradation" that increases the percentage damage and reduces the amount of damage taken. The debuff that reduces the enemy's attack speed with additional skills gives you an overwhelming advantage against heroes who usually attack. Thanks to the high recovery power of skill 2 and the super armor of skill 3, it boasts extremely high continuous combat ability and timer performance that will not be easily defeated even if it jumps into enemy territory.
weaknesses: Unless you consistently hit the enemy with your skills, you will not be able to demonstrate your true potential, so it is difficult to control, and is weak against enemies with high evasion ability or enemies that attack from a long distance. Since it relies on skill combos, if the skill activation is blocked by a silence effect, there will be nothing you can do. Also, since the disfigurement effect is canceled when the enemy performs a normal attack, the debuff's benefits are weakened against heroes and mages whose blows are powerful.

passive.name: Passive skill: Prayer of sentient beings
passive.description:
Normal attacks at close range have shorter attack intervals.
Gain 1 power of sentient beings for each normal attack (up to 6), and when the maximum is reached, you can activate Tenrai and activate an additional basic skill.
Activating the basic skill strengthens your normal attack, deals an additional 85 (85 + 35% of physical attack) magic damage to enemies within range, and recovers 75 (75 + 1.2% of additional HP) HP.
Long-range enhanced normal attacks deal 75% damage to units other than the target. (No special effects occur)

skill1.name: Skill 1: Lightning Inheritance
skill1.description: Transforms into a torrent of lightning and charges forward, dealing 200 (200 + 45% of physical attack) magic damage to enemies along the route and gaining 340 (340 + 5% of additional HP) shield for 2.5 seconds.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Surrender Divine Punishment
skill2.description:
Releases the power of lightning in front of you. When reaching the maximum distance/contacting a unit, it will explode after a certain period of time, dealing 200 (200 + 45% of physical attack) magic damage and knocking it back.
The closer you are to the unit, the greater the knockback distance.

skill3.name: Skill 3: Thousand Years of Reverberation
skill3.description:
Resonating with the reverberations of a thousand years, it floats in the air and enters the lightning body inheritance state.
During the 1.5 second status change, you gain super armor status, increasing your movement speed by 30% and ignoring terrain. In addition, Vajra uses Vajra to randomly strike nearby enemies (hero priority), dealing 100 (100 + 22% of physical attack) magic damage, gaining 1 sentient power, and gaining 160 (160 + 2.5% of additional HP) shield for 2 seconds. After landing, deals 200 (200 + 45% of physical attack) magic damage to nearby enemies.
The transformed state lasts for 8 seconds. During this time, the range of enhanced normal attacks increases, and normal attacks gain 2 sentient powers. Long-range normal attacks have a chain bolt effect that bounces between multiple enemies, dealing 86 (50% of physical attack) physical damage.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early stages, Devara is conscious of using her normal attacks to accumulate the "power of sentient beings" and activate her passive. Use skill 1's charge to damage enemies on your route while gaining a shield, and use the additional magic damage and HP recovery from enhanced normal attacks to gain an advantage in damage trading. Close-range normal attacks have a short attack interval, so use them in close combat to quickly maximize your stack and activate additional skills.
strategy.midGame: In the mid-game, ganks and self-defense that take advantage of the knockback effect of skill 2 are important. The closer you are to the enemy, the greater the knockback distance, so it is effective for knocking away approaching assassins and the like. Utilizing the activation of additional skills when the stack is at the upper limit, you can approach the enemy with skill 1 and put up a shield, and use skill 2 to control the enemy. Stay in lane longer and gain experience points with the healing effects of enhanced basic attacks.
strategy.lateGame: In the group battles in the final stages, the overwhelming control power of skill 3, "Thunder Body Inheritance State" shines. During the 1.5 second transformation, you gain super armor and the ability to move while ignoring terrain, allowing you to safely penetrate deep into enemy territory. While transforming, you will automatically strike nearby enemies with lightning and acquire a shield, dramatically increasing your survivability. After landing, it deals damage over a wide area, and can crush multiple enemies at the same time with a long-range normal attack that has a chain bolt effect.
strategy.teamfight: In teamfights, it's ideal to build up a stack of passives before joining the battle. Activate skill 3 to approach the enemy carry, ignoring the terrain, and collect hate with automatic lightning damage and shield generation. During the 8 seconds of transformation, the amount of stacks you get from normal attacks is doubled, so you can dominate the battlefield by rotating your passives at high speed and activating skills continuously. Don't forget to use skill 2 to break the enemy's formation.
strategy.commonMistakes: A common mistake is not being aware of the stack of the passive "Power of Sentient Beings" and starting a battle with an empty stack, resulting in a lack of firepower and being unable to activate additional skills. It is also dangerous to rely too much on Skill 3, which increases movement speed and ignores terrain during transformation, leaving you isolated and exposed to concentrated fire in a position where your allies can't reach you. Avoid trying to deal damage only with a single skill without taking advantage of the recovery effects of enhanced normal attacks.

strengths: Its biggest strengths are its ability to take advantage of additional skill activation through passives, as well as its continuous damage and recovery ability through enhanced normal attacks. He has high durability because he can obtain a shield with skill 1 and skill 3, and is excellent at maintaining the front line as a fighter. The terrain-ignoring mobility and super armor provided by Skill 3 allow you to engage the enemy by surprise or make sure to escape, making it extremely influential in group battles.
weaknesses: Its weakness is that it needs to be hit with regular attacks many times in order to accumulate the "power of sentient beings", and its strengths cannot be demonstrated if it is stopped by a CC (action interference) skill. Also, the knockback of skill 2 is more effective the closer you are to the enemy, so you will be at a disadvantage against enemies who mainly use poke attacks from a distance because you are more likely to take damage before you get close. The combat ability is relatively low when Skill 3 is on cooldown, so timing of engagement is important.

passive.name: Resonance/Burning
passive.description:
Communicate with the divine spear "Kasuka" and gain 1 stack of resonance when the skill is activated. Consumes all stacks during a normal attack, activates the resonance skills ``Firmness - Battle Stop'', ``Eagerness - Breaking Castle'', and ``True Intention - Ryohara'' depending on the number of stacks, and shortens the CD of ``Datsuki'' and ``Oigumo'' by 1.5 seconds.
Resonance skills can be critical hits. Activation speed increases according to own attack speed (reflection rate 50%).

skill1.name: Dangetsu
skill1.description: Raise the spear forward and then swing it down. Deals 180 (180 + 60% of additional physical attack) physical damage (2 times in total) and knocks up for 0.5 seconds when thrusting up.

forms.description: Raise the spear forward and then swing it down. Deals 180 (180 + 60% of additional physical attack) physical damage (2 times in total) and knocks up for 0.5 seconds when thrusting up.

Performs continuous attacks with a spear. Increases movement speed by 25 for 1 second, deals 124 (55 + 40% of physical attack) physical damage to enemies (4 times total), and also gains 260 (260 + 4.5% of additional HP) shield (for 2 seconds).
Activates with normal attack when resonance stacks 1.

skill2.name: Oigumo
skill2.description: Raise your spear, charge, and charge (maximum movement speed increased by 25%). After charging, charge forward and mow down the enemy, dealing 180 (180 + 60% of additional physical attack) to 360 (360 + 120% of additional physical attack) physical damage and reducing movement speed by 15% for 1 second.

forms.description: Raise your spear, charge and charge (maximum movement speed increased by 25%). After charging, charge forward and mow down the enemy, dealing 180 (180 + 60% of additional physical attack) to 360 (360 + 120% of additional physical attack) physical damage and reducing movement speed by 15% for 1 second.

Performs three consecutive attacks. The first two attacks each deal 129 (60 + 40% of physical attack) physical damage to the enemy and restore 90 HP (90 + 1.3% of additional HP). The final attack deals 258 (120 + 80% of physical attack) physical damage and restores 180 HP (180 + 2.5% of additional HP).
Activates with normal attack when resonance stacks 2. The lower the HP, the more the recovery amount will be (up to 2x).

skill3.name: Oisei
skill3.description:
Fills the tip of the spear with flame and moves it back and forth towards the front area, dealing 180 (180 + 60% of additional physical attack) physical damage each time and knocking it up.
When the maximum distance is reached, it will pierce continuously, dealing 90 (90 + 30% of additional physical attack) physical damage each time (4 times in total).
While the skill is active, you will be in a super armor state, reducing damage taken by 30%, and can activate the second stage skill "Roar of Spears" which mowing down and burning the front.
Scrape deals 180 (180 + 60% of additional physical attack) physical damage, and Burning Area deals 50 (50 + 16% of additional physical attack) magic damage once every 0.2 seconds for 3 seconds.
The second stage can be activated while "Tracing Star" is activated. Mows down the surrounding area, cancels the subsequent charge, deals 120 (120 + 40% of additional physical attack) physical damage, and burns a circular area for 3 seconds.

forms.description:
Fills the tip of the spear with flame and moves it back and forth towards the front area, dealing 180 (180 + 60% of additional physical attack) physical damage each time and knocking it up.
When the maximum distance is reached, it will pierce continuously, dealing 90 (90 + 30% of additional physical attack) physical damage each time (4 times in total).
While the skill is active, you will be in a super armor state, reducing damage taken by 30%, and can activate the second stage skill "Roar of Spears" which mowing down and burning the front.
Scrape deals 180 (180 + 60% of additional physical attack) physical damage, and Burning Area deals 50 (50 + 16% of additional physical attack) magic damage once every 0.2 seconds for 3 seconds.
The second stage can be activated while "Tracing Star" is activated. Mows down the surrounding area, cancels the subsequent charge, deals 120 (120 + 40% of additional physical attack) physical damage, and burns a circular area for 3 seconds.

After jumping into the air and gathering strength, it unleashes a ferocious blow. Deals 333 (160 + 100% of physical attack) physical damage to enemies on the route (damage increases as the target's HP is lower). The damage is maximized when the target's HP falls below 50%, dealing 666 (320 + 200% of physical attack) physical damage.
If you attack normally with 3 resonance stacks, you can ignore the terrain while jumping up. Additionally, movement speed increases by 200% and damage taken is reduced by 10%.

strategy.earlyGame: In the early stages, make full use of skill 1's launch and skill 2's charge charge to trade damage while giving CC (movement hindrance) to the enemy. Passive resonance stacks accumulate each time you use a skill, so it is important to adjust the number of stacks depending on the situation and activate the optimal resonance skill (enhanced normal attack). Spend stacks to reduce the cooldowns of Skill 1 and Skill 2, and dominate your lanes and jungles by overwhelming your opponents with fewer moves.
strategy.midGame: In the mid-game, use your mobility and powerful CC to actively gank. Charge Skill 2 to increase your movement speed, quickly close the distance to the enemy, and use a mowing motion to slow them down. From there, connect to the launch of skill 1 and use the accumulated resonance stacks to deal great damage. When you acquire Skill 3, you will be able to continuously launch enemies in a wide range while gaining super armor and damage reduction, dramatically increasing your ability to control small battles.
strategy.lateGame: In the final stages, your role is to keep pace with your allies and accurately engage the enemy's carry group. Break down enemy lines with skill 3's reciprocating launches and continuous thrusts, and use your super armor and damage reduction to withstand enemy barrage. After that, use the second stage, "Roar of the Spear," to mow down and burn the area, and use continuous magic damage to control the area, and continue rampaging while using the cooldown with continuous activation of enhanced normal attacks.
strategy.teamfight: In team battles, how you use Skill 3 will greatly influence the outcome of the battle. Activate Skill 3 by aiming at a place where there are a lot of enemies, and launch multiple enemies to create a starting point for your allies' attacks. While Skill 3 is active, you will be in a super armor state, so you can forcefully attack while nullifying the enemy's CC. Depending on the situation, you can activate the second stage of combustion from skill 2's charge cancel, and continue to deliver firepower with stack-consuming normal attacks while cutting off the enemy's escape route.
strategy.commonMistakes: If you can't manage your passive resonance stack and randomly activate enhanced normal attacks that don't suit the situation, you won't be able to get the most out of your damage and effects. Also, be careful not to make mistakes such as being vulnerable to enemy attacks while charging skill 2, or misjudging the distance of your charge and being left deep behind enemy lines. You should also avoid over-reliance on Skill 3's strong damage reduction and super armor, and rushing too far without allies following you.

synergy.reason: This is because you can control the enemy, create a reliable opening, and create a situation where you can start a combo from a dive.
It provides shielding and protection, greatly increasing your chances of survival when diving deep into enemy lines.

counters.reason: Because it has its own CC release ability and stun, it can easily counterattack divers.
Their high mobility keeps them at a distance, and their high firepower burst damage cuts them down before they can get close.

strengths: Its strength is that it can be used flexibly to suit the situation, with a variety of enhanced normal attacks depending on the number of times the skill is used. Since the cooldown of skills is shortened by the activation of enhanced normal attacks, it is very time-consuming and has excellent continuous combat ability. His ability to initiate and survive in group battles is extremely high due to multiple knock-ups from Skill 1 and Skill 3, super armor and damage reduction effect while Skill 3 is activated.
weaknesses: It is extremely difficult to operate as it requires the management of multiple skill combos and resonance stacks, and the player's skill level is directly linked to performance. Since he is the type to compete based on the number of moves he can make, his instantaneous burst damage is slightly lower than that of the Assassin. Additionally, while your powerful skill 3 is on cooldown, your influence in group battles decreases, so if your enemy avoids your skill or you are blocked by strong CC before it is activated, you will not be able to demonstrate your original tenacity and will be defeated.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Gyokuxing/Star Eye
passive.description:
Can move on walls, and normal attacks become long-range attacks (can also be activated while jumping).
The following effects are applied on the wall.
Gyokuxing: Increases Fei's charge speed by 10%
Star Eye: Increases visibility by 15%
CC Penalty: Movement speed reduction/CC time +25% granted on walls

skill1.name: Skill 1: Magadama/Tengeki
skill1.description:
Moves using the ball as a stepping stone, dealing 360 (360 + 110% of additional physical attack) physical damage to enemies along the route and knocking them up for 0.75 seconds. Also increases own attack speed by 50% and strengthens the next 3 normal attacks.
Close range: Deals an additional 75 (75 + 20% of additional physical attack) physical damage and recovers own HP by 155 (155 + 1.5% of additional maximum HP) each time.
Long range: Deals an additional 50 (50 + 13% of additional physical attack) physical damage each time. After hitting, knock away the nearest unit within range.

skill2.name: Skill 2: Stepping Ball/Hibio
skill2.description:
Step Ball: Jump from the ground to the specified wall. Jump distance increases by 4% with each level up.
Flying: Jumps freely from wall to wall, toying with the opponent.
You can stack 1 stack of ``Tread Ball/Higai'' every 10 seconds (up to 4 stacks).

skill3.name: Skill 3: Seal of condensed ball
skill3.description:
Mows down the enemy with the jade blade, inflicting 270 (270 + 80% of additional physical attack) physical damage, inflicts a stamp on all targets (on the wall, you can activate a coagulate mark with a movement effect), and becomes able to activate a "curd jade attack".
"Coagulant Attack": Explodes the engraving with the sword, dealing 160 (160 + 50% of additional physical attack) physical damage to each target. This attack negates the untargetable state. If the target's HP is 1/8 or less, you can always destroy the enemy by turning it into a ball.
