strategy.earlyGame: In the early stages, take advantage of the passive effects of wall climbing and long-range normal attacks to circle the jungle and harass lanes from a safe position. Your field of vision expands on top of walls, and with skill 2, which allows you to move from wall to wall, you have overwhelming mobility, making it possible to surprise enemies from unpredictable routes. Knock enemies up by jumping off walls with skill 1, and use enhanced melee basic attacks to deal additional damage and recover HP to gain an advantage in small battles early on.
strategy.midGame: In the middle stages, use Skill 2, which has accumulated stacks, to quickly run around the entire map and actively target isolated enemies or enemies whose HP has decreased. A powerful combo is to stamp enemies in a wide range with skill 3 from above the wall, then jump down with skill 1 and hit them with CC and enhanced normal attacks. Don't miss the timing when the enemy's HP decreases, activate the second stage of skill 3 to explode the engraving, and use the guaranteed kill effect that ignores target unavailability to reliably kill the enemy.
strategy.lateGame: In group battles in the final stages, it is essential to avoid head-on battles and observe the enemy's position from the top of the walls to compensate for their low durability. When your allies start fighting and the enemy's HP is reduced, launch a surprise attack from the wall. He plays the role of an assassin who imprints marks on multiple enemies with his skill 3, wide-range mowing, and immediately executes enemies whose HP is reduced to 1/8 or less with "Jade". After getting a kill, run back into the wall and do a hit-and-run.
strategy.teamfight: In group battles, you can secure your line of sight from the safety of a wall and look for opportunities to target the enemy's rearguard (marksmen and mages). Skill 1 allows you to jump off the wall and disrupt enemy formations with a knockup, and control the enemy's distance with the long-range knockback of your enhanced normal attack. The most important thing is how to use the execution effect of Skill 3, and it is expected to be useful as a finisher that scatters engravings on all enemies and then wipes out enemies whose HP has decreased.
strategy.commonMistakes: Although you have excellent mobility and visibility on the wall, there is a big penalty such as movement speed reduction and CC time increased by 25%, so it is a common mistake to get fatally injured on the wall if you are hit by an enemy's interference skill. Also, if you neglect skill 2 stack management and are left stranded on the ground with no means of wall movement, you will be extremely vulnerable. If you are too fixated on the execution effect of skill 3 and use the skill before the enemy's HP decreases, you will not be able to use all your firepower.

synergy.reason: In group battles, it absorbs the enemy's attention and CC skills, allowing you to safely intervene in battle.
It breaks up enemy formations on the front lines, making it easy to aim at isolated enemies or soft targets in the rear.

counters.reason: Targeted hard CC will surely stop the movement and completely neutralize high mobility such as wall movement.
A strong suppression effect can stop a surprise attack and cause the enemy to focus on you.

strengths: His greatest strength is his passive ability to move freely through walls and skill 2, allowing him to surprise attacks from routes that other heroes cannot and his overwhelming mobility. In addition to the ability to secure a wide field of view from the top of the wall, skill 3's execution ability, which can nullify the untargetable state and kill enemies with HP 1/8 or less without any questions asked, poses a great threat to the enemy. By using Skill 1's launch and enhanced normal attacks, you can engage in flexible battles at short and long range depending on the situation.
weaknesses: If you receive CC while on a wall, the effect time will be extended due to the penalty, so your ability to deal with enemies with hard CC will be extremely limited. Since it specializes in mobility, its own durability is low, and it is extremely weak in situations where it fights head-on in ground combat. Also, in order to take advantage of the execution effect of powerful skill 3, allies need to reduce the enemy's HP in advance, and they do not have the continuous firepower to reduce the enemy's HP by themselves.

passive.name: little fire hawk
passive.description:
Normal attacks fire bullets with area damage and additionally deal physical damage equal to 0.5% of the target's maximum HP. When attacking on the ground, cannonballs are blocked by enemy heroes.
I'll make it work no matter what - I'm Captain Firehawk!

skill1.name: Temporary reinforcement bullet
skill1.description:
Loads reinforced shells and strengthens the next three normal attacks. Enhanced normal attacks have a larger area attack effect, dealing 180 (180 + 40% of additional physical attack) physical damage to the target and additional physical damage of 1% of the target's maximum HP.
--Part of the cost of the enhanced bullets created by Captain Firehawk is covered by the help of the indomitable mechanical arm, but unfortunately the budget is limited.

skill2.name: Meet the legendary heroes!
skill2.description:
Throw a smoke bomb and set up a smoke screen. You and your allies inside the smokescreen gain stealth for 3.5 seconds. At the same time, you will ride the explosive air current, greatly increasing your movement speed for 0.8 seconds. While in the air, you can move, attack normally, activate skills, and ignore terrain. You can extend your flight time by using normal attacks and skill 3 while in the air.
When skill 2 is activated in the air, smoke bombs will not be fired, but normal attacks will not be blocked by the enemy.
-- "Let's surprise them!" Firehawk's appearance was created by Captain Firehawk himself.

skill3.name: Rakuyo Sea fireworks show
skill3.description:
Jump high into the air, become super armored for a period of time, and fire 5 missiles at each enemy hero you lock onto. Each time the missile explodes, it deals 350 (350 + 80% of additional physical attack) physical damage to enemies within range, and additional physical damage equal to 6% of the target's lost HP. If you hit the same target multiple times, the damage from the second shot onwards will be reduced to 25%. Also, an enemy hero other than the target can receive one shot instead.
-- "Do you want to see fireworks? Or... would you like to become a firework?" Alessio asks.

weaknesses: Since much of its mobility relies on aerial movement, it is vulnerable in ground battles where Skills 2 and 3 are on cooldown, making it difficult to escape. passive.name: Serpent Flame Messenger
passive.description:
Slash the enemy with the Engetsuto during a normal attack. Engetsuto continues to cut enemies for 6 seconds, inflicting physical damage on each hit and reducing the CD of Skill 1 by up to 0.15 seconds.
Engetsuto's attacks have a special effect of 30% of normal attacks, and you can gain visibility of the enemy you cut.
A maximum of two Engetsutos can be stacked.

skill1.name: blood fang
skill1.description: Summons one Engetsuto and increases own movement speed by 45% (decreases over 2 seconds). When attacking, Engetsuto cuts the target continuously for 6 seconds, dealing 74 (40 + 20% of physical attack) physical damage each time. While the skill is active, you can jump over walls. The cutting speed of the Engetsuto increases by up to 25% depending on the level.

skill2.name: snake kiss
skill2.description:
Summons Fire Snake to the specified location. After a certain period of time, Fire Snake will charge towards itself, dealing 320 (320 + 80% of additional physical attack) magic damage to enemies along its path and reducing their movement speed by 25% for 2 seconds.
If Firesnake owns the Engetsuto, the enemy hit by the Firesnake will be cut by the Engetsuto.
If Firesnake does not own the Engetsuto, the CD of Skill 2 will be reduced by 50%.
The activation motion of this skill becomes shorter as the attack speed increases.

skill3.name: blazing glare
skill3.description:
Fires a fire snake in the specified direction, dealing 480 (480 + 120% of additional physical attack) magic damage to enemies along the route and inflicting blindness for 2 seconds.
Immediately summons one Engetsuto and strengthens itself for 6 seconds. During the enhancement period, energy is accumulated when attacking or being attacked by an enemy, and each time energy reaches the upper limit, it deals 240 (240 + 60% of additional physical attack) magic damage to enemies within range and knocks them up for 0.5 seconds.
Enemies affected by the blinding effect can no longer be damaged by normal attacks, and projectiles when activating skills will randomly deviate from the target.

Because it has high burst damage and can instantly kill Luanna before she grows up.

In the self-strengthened state of skill 3, it boasts enough suppressing power to disrupt group battles by itself, with area-wide knock-ups due to the energy accumulation of both offense and defense.
weaknesses: Since it does not have instantaneous burst damage, it is not good at fighting like an assassin, which cuts down the enemy's HP all at once. passive.description: Lost HP is accumulated as a low HP mode for 7 seconds. skill1.name: wave walk

If Skill 1 hits multiple enemies, the damage will be reduced by 20% for each enemy, up to a maximum of 60% of the original damage. Deals 30% additional damage to minions.
When landing for the second time, somersault in the specified direction. While skill 1 is active, you will gain super armor status.

skill2.name: sea ​​anchor

Throws an anchor in the specified direction, dealing 225 (225 + 70% of additional physical attack) physical damage to enemies along the route and reducing enemy movement speed by 30% for 1.5 seconds. When the anchor hits a wall or other terrain, it will rush forward and slam enemies along its route into the wall, dealing 250 (250 + 10% of additional HP) physical damage and stunning them for 0.5 seconds.
Passive effect: After skill 2 is activated, strengthens the next normal attack and draws the target in front of you.

skill3.name: ghost ship

While skill 3 is active, White Anchor becomes super armored.

passive.description:
If the target is far away, use a normal attack to throw a rotating flying blade. The next long-range attack cannot be performed until the flying blade is returned to hand. If you tap a normal attack just before the flying blade returns, you can quickly move forward, bounce the flying blade, and attack again. Damage increases by 1.5 for every 1% of attack speed, and damage and flying speed of flying blade increase by 5% for each bounce (up to 3 times).
If the target is close, it enters close-range combat mode and quickly attacks the enemy 3 times, dealing physical damage equal to 110% of the total physical attack.

skill2.name: feather storm

Deals physical damage equal to 110 + 38% of additional physical attack and recovers own HP by 45 + 0.8% of additional HP (recovery amount is halved if hitting a non-hero unit). skill3.name: last dance

Restores Azuma's glory and deals physical damage equal to 400 + 140% of additional physical attack to nearby enemies, temporarily increases HP by 50% and movement speed by 50% (continuously decreases). The unyielding state lasts for 4 seconds, and the recovery effect during that time will be reflected when the unyielding state ends.

If you lose all of this temporary HP, the indomitable state ends immediately. Also, the temporary HP gained when resurrecting from death will be 50% of the normal activation.

Even if you are defeated, if Skill 3 is not on cooldown, you will be able to revive on the spot and return to battle while dealing great damage to those around you, so boldly push the front lines and create opportunities for your allies.
strategy.teamfight: In group battles, the timing of skill 3's activation and the bounce operation of the passive flying blade will determine the outcome of the battle. While in the indomitable state of skill 3, attack the enemy's key man with skill 2 consecutive attacks and aim for a kill with the final additional damage. During the 4 seconds of indomitable state, the recovery effect accumulates and is reflected at the end, increasing the chance of surviving even while receiving damage. It is also excellent as a decoy, using the resurrection passive as a shield to forcibly initiate and waste the opponent's powerful skills.
strategy.commonMistakes: You must be careful not to make the mistake of forgetting that you cannot perform long-distance attacks before the flying blade returns to your hand, and allowing the enemy to approach you in a defenseless state. Also, if you are overconfident in the temporary HP of skill 3 and make a reckless charge, your temporary HP will be depleted in less than 4 seconds and your indomitable state will end immediately, you will be defeated easily. It would also be a fatal mistake to rush into enemy territory without realizing that Skill 3 is on cooldown and thinking that you can revive it.

synergy.reason: Because he can provide CC and strongly support her highly mobile engagement.
Because you can remove movement obstructions, you can greatly increase your survival rate when jumping into enemy territory.

counters.reason: Because she has her own CC release and stun, her combos can be easily blocked.
Because it has a guaranteed target stun and its mobility is completely blocked.

strengths: Its strength is its ability to fight at a variety of ranges, thanks to its special normal attack that combines long-range poke and short-range burst, and ability to move and self-heal while attacking with Skill 2. The biggest weapon is skill 3, which temporarily greatly increases durability (indomitable state) and the ability to revive with ranged damage that is automatically activated upon death. This allows you to destroy enemy lines like a tank while still being an assassin or fighter, and even if you are defeated once, you can become a threat again.
weaknesses: The difficulty level of the operations is extremely high, and the skill of the player is tested, such as the rebounding of the passive flying blade and the use of attacks depending on the distance. Because it relies on skill 3's indomitability and resurrection ability, it is extremely vulnerable while skill 3 is on cooldown, making it difficult to participate in teamfights. Also, I'm not good at enemies with super burst damage that can instantly wipe out the temporary HP of skill 3, or compositions that reliably chain CC to take advantage of the opening after revival.

Close-range attack: Throws the Divine Staff of Fate while spinning, dealing 260 (260 + 45% of magic attack) magic damage to the enemy hit and reducing movement speed by 15% for 2 seconds. Recovers 150 HP (150 + 5% of additional HP) each time you attack an enemy with the stamp.
Ranged Attack: If the illusion hits the same enemy multiple times, the damage from the second hit will be 50%. Close-range attack: Can recover up to 3 times.

Skill 1's long-range attack deals damage to the enemy while imprinting a seal to keep them in check. If the enemy approaches, use Skill 2 to retreat and maintain a long-range state to increase movement speed, or switch to a close-range state and increase maximum HP and MP while recovering, increasing your survivability and gaining an advantage in lane battles.
strategy.midGame: In the middle stages, flexible combat is required by switching between long-range and short-range combat. When you attack an enemy that has been engraved with Skill 1, the cooldown will be reduced, allowing you to deal continuous damage. Close-range attacks attack nearby enemies, slowing them down, and hit enemies with the stamp to heal them. Skill 3 allows you to record your position during long-distance attacks, so the strategy of jumping into enemy territory and then returning to a safe position becomes effective.
strategy.lateGame: In team battles in the final stages, make the most of your own durability and survival ability. Absorb enemy attacks by utilizing the damage reduction and super armor provided by skill 3's area deployment, and maintain the front line with a powerful recovery effect that increases according to the amount of HP lost. In addition, if there is an allied tower within the area, you can return the tower's state to 5 seconds ago, so it plays a very important role in defensive battles and can nullify enemy attacks.
strategy.teamfight: In group battles, use Skill 2 to obtain buffs based on the number of enemies. The recovery effect when switching to a close-range state and the movement speed increase when switching to a long-range state will be stronger the more enemy heroes are around you, so timing when you rush into enemy territory is key. While recovering by involving enemies with short-range attacks, when in danger, use skill 3 to deal damage after 1.5 seconds and instantly escape to a pre-recorded safe position to survive.
strategy.commonMistakes: A common mistake is to use Skill 3 without knowing where it was recorded and end up returning to a dangerous location. Also, even if you use Skill 2 to attack the enemy camp when there are few enemies, the recovery effect and increase in movement speed will not be maximized, and there is a risk that your durability will be insufficient and you will be defeated. Furthermore, you should avoid wasting skill 1 on enemies that have no engravings and losing the benefit of cooldown reduction, resulting in a decrease in firepower.

synergy.reason: Because you can reset the cooldown of skills and activate Heino's powerful ultimate continuously.
By combining teleport and Heino's ultimate that turns back time, it will be easier to return to the front and recover.

counters.reason: This is because you can quickly close the distance and defeat Heino with high burst damage before he can recover.
Because it has strong CC and can create a starting point to restrain Heino and defeat him without using his ultimate.

strengths: Its greatest strengths are its flexibility in switching between short and long range, and its high survivability through self-healing. Close-range attacks increase durability by recovering HP and increasing maximum HP, while long-range attacks provide continuous damage from a safe range and increased mobility by increasing movement speed. Also, the ability to restore the tower with skill 3 and the ability to escape to a safe position with damage reduction and super armor gives him a tactical advantage over other heroes in both offense and defense.
weaknesses: The weak point is that it is essential to add and maintain engravings in order to generate firepower and recover. Additionally, you will not be able to move while skill 3 is deployed, so if you deploy in the wrong location, you run the risk of being surrounded by enemies and receiving concentrated fire. In addition, his strength in close-range mode requires him to jump into enemy lines, so he is weak to CC (contravention) skills, and if he is defeated before skill 3 is activated, he will not be able to demonstrate his amazing survivability, which is his strength.

You can also use your passive idleness to randomly restore HP, allowing you to stay in lane longer and earn experience points and gold.

Activating Magi Mode instantly restores your energy and increases the stack limit to 3 gauge, allowing you to perform a series of furious combos. By increasing movement speed and reducing movement speed reduction effects, you can get close to soft enemies in the rear line while getting through enemy obstructions. Increase your survival rate and deal damage with super armor and skill 2 derivative combos (2+2) that have damage reduction effects.
strategy.teamfight: In group battles, it is powerful to use the damage reduction and super armor of skill 2 to rush into enemy lines, and to incapacitate multiple enemies with range knockup of skill 1's derived combo (1+1). It is also dangerous to forget to recover due to laziness, move around in vain, and participate in battle with your HP resources depleted. Additionally, if you jump in without anticipating the enemy's CC skill and are defeated before you can deploy the super armor state of skill 2, you will not be able to utilize your natural durability and combos at all.

strategy.earlyGame: Butterfly has a fast jungle traversal speed from the beginning, and her continuous skills using the passive imprint system are powerful. Defeat monsters and collect 3 stacks of engravings, then head to the gank and use skills with no cooldowns to deal massive damage to your enemies. By using skill 1's shield and movement speed increase to quickly approach enemies, and skill 2's slowing effect to block escape routes, you can aim for a sure kill from the beginning.
strategy.midGame: In the middle stages, you will gain kills and assists, accumulate passive stamps, and demonstrate your strengths as an assassin aiming for consecutive kills. Use skill 3 to jump into the enemy and forcefully continue the battle by using the effect of recovering 35% of the damage dealt during the duration of the stamp given to the target. The cooldown of the special technique is reset when a kill occurs with skill 3, so it is important to aim at the enemies whose HP has decreased one after another and collapse the enemy camp.
strategy.lateGame: In group battles in the final stages, you will need to be able to reliably take down enemy carries (firepower) and targets with low HP. If you take the lead carelessly, you will be hit with a barrage of fire, so be sure to time your allies to engage and the enemy's control skills are exhausted. Ideally, you should use skill 3 to jump into the enemy's rear line, take a kill with guaranteed damage based on the HP lost, and chain the passive and skill 3 CD reset to deal with enemies in succession.
strategy.teamfight: In group battles, always keep track of the enemy's HP status and attack from the target you can definitely kill. Skill 1 is useful during melee battles because the more enemies it hits, the more damage it deals, and the more you can acquire a shield at the same time. After jumping in with Skill 3, use your normal attack to hit the imprinted enemy to reduce the cooldown of Skills 1 and 2, reduce the damage of normal attacks by 50%, and recover HP to survive and disrupt the battle line.
strategy.commonMistakes: A common mistake is to recklessly charge into the enemy's camp without having enough engravings, and then be defeated without being able to do anything after using up all your skills. Also, it can be fatal if you use Skill 3 on the wrong target and jump into a tank with full HP and can't get a kill or benefit from the cooldown. Always check the number of passive stacks and the target's remaining HP, and don't forget to attack based on the chain of kill resets.

synergy.reason: Because it can give CC immunity and damage reduction, and you can aim for a chain of kill recovery without being hindered.
This is because you can stop the enemy with a long-range stun, creating an opening for Butterfly to safely jump in.

counters.reason: Because it has CC range and high durability, and can break the chain of Butterfly's skill reset.
This is because you can use your invincibility judgment and recovery to avoid Butterfly's burst damage while also counterattacking it.

strengths: His biggest strength is his ability to eliminate skill cooldowns with his passive, and his overwhelming ability to kill continuously with skill 3, which resets his secret upon kill. It boasts unparalleled strength when the enemy's HP is low, and has the explosive power to turn the tide of battle on its own. Furthermore, his ability to survive in melee is extremely high even though he is an assassin due to his skill 1's shield and skill 3's recovery and normal attack damage reduction effect, which is a big attraction.
weaknesses: The weakness is that if you can't get kills or assists, you won't benefit from passives, and your firepower will be significantly reduced. Additionally, he lacks the ability to engage in group battles on his own, and his fragility is exposed when he gets caught by the enemy's CC (action interference) skills. In situations where the enemy is equipped with armor and has high HP, or where the support is protecting the target with a powerful shield, you will not be able to use your specialty kill reset, and your influence in the battle will be rapidly lost.
